The plan works for me. The automatic-title part is exactly what I asked about — pasting a link starts finding the title on its own, I can still edit it, and it won't stomp on a title I've typed myself. I also like that saving isn't held up if the title lookup is slow or fails.

The rest lines up with what I want too: browsing newest-first, searching across titles/addresses/notes/tags, filtering by tags and favorites, editing, archiving and restoring, and a confirmation before anything is permanently deleted.

Go ahead and generate the tasks and start building.
